# Neural Icons

> Optional framework-independent SVG mask icons for NeuralNg using CSS classes.

## Rules

- Install `@neural-ng/icons` separately from `@neural-ng/core`.
- Import `@neural-ng/icons/icons.css` once for the curated 67-icon set.
- Use `outline.css`, `filled.css`, `all.css`, `brands.css`, or a
  `categories/{name}.css` entry point only when that larger set is required.
- Filled category entry points use `categories/filled/{name}.css`.
- Read `@neural-ng/icons/metadata.json` for names, styles, categories, and
  inventory counts; do not scrape generated CSS.
- Render icons with `class="nt nt-{name}"`; do not generate a NeuralIconComponent.
- Filled icons use `class="nt nt-filled-{name}"` and never override outline icons.
- Add `aria-hidden="true"` to decorative icons.
- Put the accessible name on an icon-only button or link, not on the icon.
- Icons inherit `color` and use `1em` dimensions.
- Use `nt-spin` only with an icon class such as `nt-spinner`.
- Use `nt-spin-reverse` for whole-icon counter-clockwise motion.
- Use `nt-spin-dual` for counter-rotating layers. The only native layered icon
  is currently `loader-3`; other icons fall back to a whole-icon spin.
- Customize motion with `--nt-spin-duration` and
  `--nt-spin-inner-duration`. Never disable reduced-motion handling.
- NeuralNg components must remain compatible with other icon libraries.
- Strict Content Security Policy deployments must permit `data:` in the
  effective `img-src` directive because SVG masks are embedded in CSS.

## Canonical examples

```html
<i class="nt nt-user" aria-hidden="true"></i>

<neural-button ariaLabel="Open profile">
  <i class="nt nt-user" aria-hidden="true"></i>
</neural-button>

<i class="nt nt-spinner nt-spin" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="nt nt-loader-3 nt-spin-dual" aria-hidden="true"></i>
```

The curated icon list and aliases are in `manifest.json`. The full inventory
is generated directly from the pinned `@tabler/icons` package; do not hand-edit
generated CSS.
